purpose: Attach derivations to the MiniMax numbers asserted on 2026-08-03 and re-check every one that can still be re-derived. Written because those token and cache figures were prose with no stated source.

derivation.query: select sum(cached_read_tokens) from logs where provider='Minimax';

minimax_cached_read_tokens_total.note: Now over 207 requests and 3,703,946 prompt tokens, up from 45 requests. The finding strengthened rather than drifted: MiniMax has never once recorded a cached read through Bifrost.

derivation.query: select sum(cached_read_tokens) from logs where provider='CodexOpenAI';

codexopenai_caches_by_contrast.note: A cumulative counter over a live log; growth is correct behaviour. The claim it supports — that Bifrost cache accounting works for at least one provider, so zero for MiniMax is meaningful — holds.

derivation.query: sum of prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens over all lines

runner_smoke_totals.note: The raw per-job JSONL survives, so these totals are re-derivable from the artifact rather than trusted.

proxy_cache_control_two_call_test.why_not: Point-in-time responses from a live provider. go-llm-proxy does not persist per-request usage, and these calls bypassed Bifrost, so nothing on disk records them. The numbers were read from the responses at the time and cannot be re-checked now.
proxy_cache_control_two_call_test.how_to_make_future_runs_verifiable: Have the runner write its raw usage to a JSONL artifact, as scripts/mm-bulk-runner.mjs already does for smoke jobs.

transfer_rate_33_88_mbps.why_not: Read from rsync progress output, which was not captured to a durable artifact. The SHA-256 and byte counts from that loop WERE verified and remain checkable; only the throughput figure is unbacked.

conclusion: Of the MiniMax figures asserted on 2026-08-03, the load-bearing one — MiniMax cached reads are zero while another provider on the same gateway caches — re-derives exactly and has strengthened. The per-call proxy figures cannot be re-checked and are now labelled as such rather than presented as settled measurements.
